title: What Nalanda University Actually Looked Like
description: Eight hundred years before Oxford's first lectures, students crossed Asia to study in Bihar. A look inside Nalanda at its peak.

scenes.narration: Before Oxford held its first lecture, students were walking across Asia to reach one place in Bihar.
scenes.image_prompt: a lone young monk traveller in saffron robes walking on a dusty road toward a vast red brick monastery complex at sunrise, Bihar plains, 7th century India

scenes.narration: This is Nalanda, founded in the fifth century under the Gupta kings.
scenes.image_prompt: wide aerial view of ancient Nalanda Mahavihara, rows of tall red brick monasteries and temples with courtyards, green fields around, morning mist

scenes.narration: You walk past rows of brick monasteries. Each one is a courtyard ringed with small cells where students live and study.
scenes.image_prompt: inside a red brick monastery courtyard of ancient Nalanda, small doorways of student cells around the square, monks reading palm leaf manuscripts, soft light

scenes.narration: Teachers debate logic, medicine, grammar and Buddhist philosophy. Getting in is hard. Gatekeepers are said to test you at the door.
scenes.image_prompt: two scholars in robes debating passionately before seated students on a stone platform, ancient Indian university, warm afternoon light

scenes.narration: In the seventh century, the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang studied here and wrote about thousands of monks and teachers.
scenes.image_prompt: Chinese Buddhist pilgrim Xuanzang in Tang dynasty robes writing with a brush by oil lamp inside an ancient Indian monastery cell, scrolls around him

scenes.narration: Its library held manuscripts on palm leaves, copied by hand, generation after generation.
scenes.image_prompt: tall dim library hall of ancient Nalanda with shelves of stacked palm leaf manuscripts tied with string, monk copying a manuscript, shafts of light

scenes.narration: Around 1200, invading forces sacked it. Old accounts say the library burned for months.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient brick monastery library engulfed in flames at night, smoke rising into the dark sky, burning manuscripts, dramatic orange glow

scenes.narration: Today its ruins are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Which ancient place should we rebuild next? Tell me below.
scenes.image_prompt: present day ruins of Nalanda University, weathered red brick walls and stairways under a blue sky, golden hour, tourists small in the distance
